Section 17: where the right or the facts were concealed by fraud, or the suit is for relief from a mistake, time runs from when it was discovered.
Check whether the suit, as actually framed, falls under a different article with a longer period or a later starting point.

output.statute_applied: Article 55, Limitation Act, 1963 — 3 years (Compensation for breach of contract)
output.fatal_flaw: Counting 3 years under Article 55 from 15 January 2023, the last day to file is 15 January 2026. The filing on 20 February 2026 is 36 days after that, and is in time only if the 60 days spent in pre-institution mediation are excluded under Section 12A(5) of the Commercial Courts Act, 2015, which moves the last day to 16 March 2026.
curative_strategies: File on or before 16 March 2026, and plead the Section 12A(5) exclusion expressly in the plaint.
The exclusion applies only to a commercial dispute of specified value in which pre-institution mediation under Section 12A was actually undertaken. Confirm both before relying on it.
Keep the mediation application and the Mediation Authority's report: they are the proof of the dates excluded.
Without the exclusion the suit is 36 days late, and delay in filing a suit cannot be condoned — Section 5 applies to appeals and applications, not suits.
